import bpy,bmesh,json
from mathutils import Vector
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['bank15'];craft=ns['craft'];surface=ns['surface'];cap=ns['cap']
assert not craft.get('bank15_lumber_beds')
timber=[o for o in craft.objects if o.name.startswith('Combined_rear_B sawn timber stack')]
bpy.context.view_layer.update()
pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(p) for o in timber for p in o.bound_box]
oldbase=min(p.z for p in pts);newbase=oldbase+.115
for o in timber:o.location.z+=.115
supports=[]
for index,y in enumerate([6.02,7.96]):
 x,X=4.35,5.48;a,b=y-.18,y+.18
 # The lower four corners follow the existing bank; the upper seat is horizontal.
 vs=[(x,a,surface(x,a)-.028),(X,a,surface(X,a)-.028),(X,b,surface(X,b)-.028),(x,b,surface(x,b)-.028),(x,a,newbase+.004),(X,a,newbase+.004),(X,b,newbase+.004),(x,b,newbase+.004)]
 assert all(v[2]<newbase for v in vs[:4])
 me=bpy.data.meshes.new('B15 lumber stone bed '+str(index));me.from_pydata(vs,[],[(0,3,2,1),(0,1,5,4),(1,2,6,5),(2,3,7,6),(3,0,4,7),(4,5,6,7)]);me.materials.append(bpy.data.materials['B15_CoursedStone_2']);me.update();ns['uv_stone'](me)
 o=bpy.data.objects.new(me.name,me);craft.objects.link(o);o['bank15_lumber_bed']=True
 be=o.modifiers.new('Dressed support edges','BEVEL');be.width=.012;be.segments=1
 no=o.modifiers.new('Support planes','WEIGHTED_NORMAL');no.keep_sharp=True
 supports.append({'name':o.name,'top':newbase+.004,'ground_corners':[v[2]+.028 for v in vs[:4]]})
craft['bank15_lumber_beds']=True
bpy.context.view_layer.update();bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
(cap/'lumber_supports.json').write_text(json.dumps({'old_base':oldbase,'new_base':newbase,'timber_objects':len(timber),'supports':supports},indent=2),encoding='utf8')
print('B15_LUMBER_BEDS',supports)
